remarks: Waterfront living at its finest in East Norwalk! This sought-after 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo in the upscale River Watch complex offers breathtaking, year-round views of the Norwalk River from your private balcony. Watch herons, egrets & swans glide across the water as you relax in this serene & picturesque setting. Freshly painted throughout-including ceilings, walls & all trim-this home feels bright, airy & move-in ready. Open floor plan features gleaming hardwood floors & new light fixtures. The modern kitchen is well-appointed with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, newer refrigerator & brand-new microwave. Spacious living & dining areas are perfect for entertaining, while the primary suite offers a new ceiling fan, blackout curtains, a full bath with new blinds & ample closet space. The second bedroom is generously sized with easy access to the additional full bath, also with new blinds for added privacy. Newer HVAC system ensures efficient heating & central A/C for year-round comfort. Convenient in-unit laundry adds to the ease of living. This elevator building provides one-level, no-step living with secured garage parking (1 assigned space) & an additional reserved outdoor parking spot. There is also secure storage for bikes, kayaks & paddleboards, plus access to the waterside boardwalk for a scenic stroll. For boating enthusiasts, boat slip rentals are available at two marinas just outside your door. Enjoy an unbeatable location-close to the East Norwalk
